verdict.line: You lose if you let Urgot's E (Disdain) catch you and chain into his Purge/Echoing Flames burst; you win if you out-poke him with mini Gnar's longer Q and punish his 14-16s E cooldown with Mega Gnar bursts.

brief.thesis: Both champions are ranged poke duelists, but only Urgot has a hard engage: E (Disdain) dashes 475 range, tramples minions, and stops to throw you out of position if it connects a champion. Gnar's mini form outranges him with Q (Boomerang Throw) at 1100 vs Urgot's 800-range Q and 490-range W, so the lane is won or lost on whether you stay outside 475-490 range until Rage builds. Once Mega Gnar is online, his E (Crunch) and W (Wallop) give you the only hard engage in the lane, which is the counter to Urgot's lack of an escape dash.

theirWindow.when: His E is off cooldown and you're in range
theirWindow.what: Once Disdain (16/15.5/15/14.5/14s cooldown) is up, Urgot can charge 475 units, trample minions, and if he connects he stops and throws you out of position directly into his Q (Corrosive Charge) and W (Purge) follow-up. Hold Q pokes from max range rather than walking up to trade autos while this is live.

yourWindow.when: Rage is near max and his E is down
yourWindow.what: Transform into Mega Gnar and commit with E (Crunch)'s ground slam or W (Wallop)'s stun — Urgot has no dash to escape it once Disdain is on cooldown, so this is the one window you can force a real fight instead of trading pokes.

powerCurve.note: Urgot's Q/E poke-and-engage beats low-Rage mini Gnar

Trinity Force online, Mega Gnar bursts punish his E cooldown
Full kite build outscales his lack of an escape dash

start.why: Highest-performing start in the data (49.2% over 63 games, 53.9% pick); the extra sustain and damage let mini Gnar win the early auto/Q poke exchanges before Rage builds.

boots.why: By far the most picked boot (91.1% pick, 46.1% WR over 102 games); Urgot's damage leans on basic attacks and his Echoing Flames passive triggers off autos and Purge, so flat reduction blunts both.

core.why: The Spellblade proc and move speed spike let Mega Gnar stick to Urgot the moment his E (Disdain) is down, turning your one engage window into a real punish.
Shreds the armor Urgot builds against you (Randuin's/Thornmail) and its stacking move speed passive helps mini Gnar kite between pokes.
Health and tenacity keep you alive through his Q slow chains and buy survival margin against the R (Fear Beyond Death) execute threshold.

situational.when: if urgot is building toward an all-in burst and you need the attack speed slow and extra health to survive it
if urgot is stacking heavy physical damage or lifesteal and you need the grievous wounds to shut down his sustain

runes.keystoneWhy: The move speed burst and heal on landed abilities fit a lane about repositioning — you're constantly weaving Q pokes and E hops while staying outside his 475-490 range. Master-tier Gnar players (1,803 games) favor Lethal Tempo instead, which rewards committing to extended attack-speed trades once ahead; that's fine if you're confident out-dueling his Purge channel, but Fleet Footwork is the safer pick into his Echoing Flames poke.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the dominant pick (61.5% pick rate) and lets you reset waves safely in a lane that's won through poke attrition rather than all-ins. Exhaust+Flash (17.1% pick) is a reasonable alternative if you want a direct answer to his E (Disdain) engage window.

playing.title: Poke from max Q range
playing.detail: Throw Boomerang Throw from near its 1100 range rather than walking into his 475-490 range; catching the return cuts the cooldown and keeps the poke war one-sided.

playing.title: Respect the E window
playing.detail: Track his E (Disdain) cooldown (16-14.5s) and don't stand in 475 range while it's up — getting caught is how he displaces you into Purge and Echoing Flames.

playing.title: Build Rage without committing
playing.detail: Fight at range to stack Rage safely; save the Mega Gnar transform for a moment when his E is down so he can't dash away from your E (Crunch) or W (Wallop).

playing.title: Play around his R from level 6
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death can execute you under its HP threshold at 2500 range — don't sit below half HP near level 6+ once he has it up.

playing.title: Punish the Purge channel
playing.detail: Urgot slows himself while using W (Purge); if he opens it at bad range, walk out of 490 range or burst him while his move speed is reduced.

playing.title: Don't force all-ins
playing.detail: The head-to-head sits at 46.7% over 105 games with a solo-kill edge to Urgot — let poke decide skirmishes and only commit Mega Gnar when his engage is down.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the win-rate figures above come from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the ability interactions and trade timing are my own read of the kit.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with (E). Maintain your distance while focusing on kiting.
